The groom, wearing a black tuxedo with a white shirt and bow tie, stands facing the bride, who is in a white wedding gown holding a bouquet. An officiant in a light suit stands between them. In the background, there is a river and city buildings.

The geometry of the buildings in the background is slightly warped, and the water texture has a repetitive, painterly quality rather than realistic fluid dynamics.
The edge of the bride's veil bleeds slightly into the background sky/buildings, lacking a sharp occlusion boundary.
